task.title: Change the interface theme
task.shortdesc: Select system, light, or dark theme without changing profile content.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Theme selection affects only the BPM interface and helps review tables, code blocks, validation states, and warnings comfortably.

step.cmd: Open the theme selector in the page header.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.
Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Check that editor panels, tables, notes, focus indicators, and validation states remain readable.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Continue editing after confirming that unsaved profile data is still present.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: BPM uses the selected visual theme across supported surfaces.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
